---
title: "Cars - radioButtons"
format: dashboard
server: shiny
---

```{r}
#| context: setup
library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
df <- mpg
```

# Plots

## {.sidebar}

```{r}
radioButtons("year", "Model year", choices = c(1999, 2008))
```

## Column

```{r}
#| title: Highway mpg by class
plotlyOutput("p1")
```

```{r}
#| title: Engine size
plotlyOutput("p2")
```

# Data

```{r}
#| title: Cars
DTOutput("tbl")
```

```{r}
#| context: server
filtered <- reactive(df |> filter(year == input$year))
output$p1 <- renderPlotly({
  ggplotly(ggplot(filtered(), aes(class, hwy)) + geom_boxplot())
})
output$p2 <- renderPlotly({
  ggplotly(ggplot(filtered(), aes(displ)) + geom_histogram(bins = 15))
})
output$tbl <- renderDT(datatable(filtered()))
```
